title: Power ranking: the best English players right now
checked: Kane won the 2026 Ballon d'Or, 1055 points to Mbappe 1027 and Yamal 881; Bellingham 11th, Rice 15th; Kane 73 goals for club and country in 2025-26 and the Gerd Muller Trophy; first English winner since Michael Owen (2001), the fifth ever (Wikipedia 2026 Ballon d'Or, Yahoo). England 1-2 Argentina, 15 July 2026: Gordon 55' from Rogers' cross, Enzo Fernandez 85', Lautaro header 90+2 (Sky, ESPN, FIFA). England 6-4 France, third place, 18 July 2026; 4-0 at half-time; Saka hat-trick, the third a penalty (theScore, Wego, ITV). PL goals to 2 Nov: Rogers 5, Tavernier 5, Calvert-Lewin 4, Palmer 3, Saka 3 (NBC); Arsenal top (Wikipedia). Foden hat-trick, City 5-1 AEK Athens, 20 Oct 2026 (Ahram, Sports Mole). Order is our judgement, never a game rating. The Saka clip is a Knowitball penalty in the right kits; the run-up and corner are the game's.

lines.text: Twenty-five years after Michael Owen, an Englishman won the Ballon d'Or again. But who are the best English players right now?
lines.say: Twenty-five years after Michael Owen, an Englishman won the Balon Dor again. But who are the best English players, right now?

lines.text: This summer, England were minutes from a World Cup final. Gordon scored, then Argentina struck twice late on.

scene.headline: Late collapse ends England's World Cup dream
scene.standfirst: Anthony Gordon puts England ahead in Atlanta, before Enzo Fernández and a stoppage-time Lautaro Martínez header turn the semi-final.

lines.text: Ten, Cole Palmer, three for Chelsea. Nine, Dominic Calvert-Lewin, four for Leeds. Eight, Marcus Tavernier, five for Bournemouth.
lines.say: Ten, Cole Palmer, three for Chelsea. Nine, Dominic Calvert Lewin, four for Leeds. Eight, Marcus Tavvernear, five for Bornmuth.

lines.text: Seven, Phil Foden, a Champions League hat-trick against AEK Athens. Six, Anthony Gordon, England's scorer in that semi-final.
lines.say: Seven, Phil Fohden, a Champions League hat-trick against Ay ee kay Athens. Six, Anthony Gordon, England's scorer in that semi-final.

lines.text: Five, Morgan Rogers, five league goals for Chelsea. Four, Jude Bellingham, eleventh in the Ballon d'Or.
lines.say: Five, Morgan Rogers, five league goals for Chelsea. Four, Jude Bellingham, eleventh in the Balon Dor.

lines.text: Three, Declan Rice. Fifteenth in the Ballon d'Or, and Arsenal are top of the league.
lines.say: Three, Declan Rice. Fifteenth in the Balon Dor, and Arsenal are top of the league.

lines.text: Number two. Bukayo Saka. And this is why.
lines.say: Number two. Bookaiyo Sahka. And this is why.

lines.text: The third-place play-off against France. Four-nil up at half-time, six-four at the end.
Saka scored twice before the break, then finished his hat-trick from the spot.
lines.say: Sahka scored twice before the break, then finished his hat-trick from the spot.

lines.text: Seventy-three goals for club and country last season, and the Gerd Müller Trophy for the world's best striker.
lines.say: Seventy-three goals for club and country last season, and the Gerd Mewler Trophy, for the world's best striker.

scene.title: The best season of his life

lines.text: Then the Ballon d'Or itself, twenty-eight points ahead of Mbappé. Only the fifth Englishman ever to win it.
lines.say: Then the Balon Dor itself, twenty-eight points ahead of Embapay. Only the fifth Englishman ever to win it.
